payload.claim: The module docstring now reads "The reader is `run_task` and `cli._stack_mint`'s shared path in, through `attach_mutants_at`," implying both callers reach the module through the new helper. `cli._stack_mint` (saffron/cli.py:1593-1622) only calls `mutants.ref_commit(pinned.mirror)` to pin a commit on the task row; it never calls `attach_mutants_at`, which only `run_task`, `run_regate`, `package_ready_task` and `run_commit_review` call. The docstring misstates which caller goes through the new helper.
